baselineDisplay.title: Monster or Fish
baselineDisplay.question: What was the monster called?
baselineDisplay.text:
What was the monster called?

Fishermen and sailors sometimes claim to have seen monsters in the sea.
Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen, it is now known that many of these 'monsters' which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish.
Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are rarely caught out at sea.
Some time ago, however, a peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.
A small fishing boat was carried miles out to sea by the powerful fish as it pulled on the line.
Realizing that this was no ordinary fish, the fisherman made every effort not to damage it in any way.
When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long.
It had a head like a horse big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail.
The fish, which has since been set to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish.
Such creatures have rarely been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred feet.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
渔民和水手们有时声称在海上看到了怪物。
虽然人们常常嘲笑水手们讲述的故事，但现在人们知道，许多被目击的“怪物”其实只是奇怪的鱼类而已。
偶尔，一些不寻常的生物会被冲上岸，但在海上捕捉到它们的情况非常罕见。
然而，不久前，在马达加斯加附近捕获了一条奇特的鱼。
这条大鱼使劲拉着渔线，把一艘小渔船拖到了几英里外的海里。
意识到这绝不是一条普通的鱼，渔民竭尽全力避免对其造成任何伤害。
当这条鱼最终被带到岸上时，人们发现它的长度超过了十三英尺。
它有着马一样的头部、大大的蓝色眼睛、闪亮的银色皮肤以及鲜红色的尾巴。
这条鱼后来被送往一家博物馆，由一位科学家进行研究。它被称为“桨鱼”。
由于这种生物生活在六百英尺深的海域，人类很少有机会亲眼见到它们的活体。

corrections.evidence: LRC ti 元数据为 Monster or Fish?。
中文标题字段错误重复英文；按 Monster or Fish? 的选择疑问和全文海怪/鱼语境补译。

corrections.before: a head like a horse big blue eyes
corrections.after: a head like a horse, big blue eyes
corrections.evidence: had 后列举头、眼睛、皮肤、尾巴；horse 后缺少分隔并列名词的逗号。

corrections.before: a head like a horse big blue eyes
corrections.after: a head like a horse, big blue eyes
corrections.evidence: 同步正文并列名词列表标点。

corrections.before: has since been set to a museum
corrections.after: has since been sent to a museum
corrections.evidence: 被送往博物馆对应 send 的被动完成时 has been sent；同条中文为被送往，set to 不符合此处运输含义。

corrections.before: has since been set to a museum
corrections.after: has since been sent to a museum
corrections.evidence: 同步正文 sent 的明确误字订正，与中文被送往对应。

notes: 完整阅读海怪与桨鱼十句及问题。根据源元数据恢复标题问号并补齐缺失中文标题；修复马头与蓝眼睛列表缺逗号、被送往博物馆的 sent 误字，核对十三英尺长度和六百英尺深度，复检全部中英字幕。
